title: 第四十二章炼丹术第四十一章可问秘境
slug: 开局阴阳宗从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
lines: 疤爷索性懒得再劝，只是说道：“要说秘境的话，三日后倒是会有一个。”
“那个秘境每三年开启一次，机会难得，所以这次同样会有大量宗门势力参与。”
“到时候，咱们阴阳门也会派一批内门弟子进入，去里面争夺机缘。”
“而那批弟子中，每人得到一个令牌，只有持令牌者才能进入。”
这句话说出来，张守安都开始思考怎么温柔地抢来一张令牌了。
结果，疤爷却是话锋一转，停下手中的工作：“不过呢，由于一类人倒是不用。”
他手指举起指向张守安：“一部分被选中的荡妖队罪修。”
张守安有些疑问：“为什么？”
疤放下手，随后解释道：“路上总有些东西需要来人命来填，懂了吗，炮灰。”
张守安撇撇嘴，不在意地说道：“炮灰就炮灰，反倒是便宜我了。”
疤爷笑了一下，挥挥手：“这几日他们差不多就会去选人，到时候你展露一点实力，他们肯定会带实力高点的炮灰。”
张守安点点头：“那就好办了。”
疤爷见张守安没问的了，便开始赶客：“没事就滚蛋。”
张守安也不在这耗着，问完后便一口把茶水喝完，摆摆手就走了。
疤爷看着张守安离去，什么话也没多说，只是又拿起了毛笔。
张守安在刚到中午的时候，便回到了营区附近。
既然自己要去秘境了，就要做些准备了。
护甲？丹药？道具？符纸？
他瞬间觉得自己好穷，但没一会，就想起自己那可还有位炼丹师呢。
那自己要一点点丹药不过分吧。
他几步就来到了隔壁营帐，伸手就要掀帘，不过手在触摸到帐布的一瞬就立刻收了回来。
这回倒是长记性了……他清了下嗓子，说道：
“苏姑娘，我现在能进来吗？”
一道细声传了过来：“可以。”
张守安掀开帘子，便走了进去，里面映入眼帘的，就是换了一身衣服的苏晚。
她身上还是那身绿色常服，只不过今天倒是没了昨天的那种匆忙，整个人看起来更加恬静。
青绿的衣服看起来极其合身，在她修长的身段上装饰的很好。微微收紧的腰身，还有前方的微微凸起，看起来美好极了。
苏晚正在一张书桌上静静地写着字，待张守安进来后，她才抬起头看了过来。
不过张守安却是能看见，她耳朵稍稍红了一下，看起来是想起了昨天的事情。
“大人有什么事吗？”苏晚轻声问道。
张守安开门见山：“我来看看你这里有没有现成的丹药，我过几日进秘境要用。”
苏晚愣了一下，随后走到角落里，翻出来一个背包。
他翻了几下，最后取出来几只瓷瓶，说道：“就这么多了。”
他将那些瓷瓶取了过来，放在张守安前的桌子上。
她提起一只，晃了晃，然后凭感觉说道：“这里面大概有七八枚止血丹。”
“不管是普通的皮外伤，还是内伤，都能治疗，服用后几秒内就能治好。只不过效果和痛感会有所不同。”
她递给张守安：“当然，也不是那么神奇的，练气期以上的修士使用，效果可以用没有来形容。”
content_en:
Mr. Scar simply didn't bother to persuade him anymore and just said: "As for the secret realm, there will be one in three days."
"That secret realm is opened every three years. It's a rare opportunity, so this time there will also be a large number of sect forces participating."
"At that time, our Yin Yang Sect will also send a group of inner disciples to enter and compete for opportunities."
"And among those disciples, each one received a token, and only those holding the token can enter."
After saying these words, Zhang Shou'an began to think about how to gently grab a token.
As a result, Mr. Scar changed the subject and stopped what he was doing: "But, it's not necessary for this kind of people."
He raised his finger and pointed at Zhang Shou'an: "Some of the selected criminal cultivators of the demon team."
Zhang Shou'an had some questions: "Why?"
Scar put down his hand and then explained: "There are always things on the road that need to be filled with lives. Do you understand, cannon fodder?"
Zhang Shou'an curled his lips and said nonchalantly: "Cannon fodder is just cannon fodder, but it actually gives me an advantage."
Mr. Scar smiled and waved his hand: "They will be selecting people in the next few days. If you show some strength then, they will definitely bring cannon fodder with higher strength."
Zhang Shou'an nodded: "That's easy to handle."
Seeing that Zhang Shou'an had nothing to ask, Mr. Scar began to drive away the guests: "Get out of here if you have nothing to do."
Zhang Shou'an didn't want to waste time here. After asking, he drank the tea in one gulp, waved his hand and left.
Mr. Scar watched Zhang Shou'an leave without saying anything more, but just picked up the brush again.
Zhang Shou'an returned to the camp area just before noon.
Now that I am going to the secret realm, I need to make some preparations.
Armor? Pill? Props? Talisman paper?
He felt that he was so poor for a moment, but after a while, he remembered that he still had an alchemist.
Then it's not too much to ask for some elixirs for yourself.
He arrived at the tent next door in a few steps. He stretched out his hand to lift the curtain, but he pulled it back the moment his hand touched the tent.
This time he had a better memory... He cleared his throat and said:
"Miss Su, can I come in now?"
A soft voice came over: "Okay."
Zhang Shou'an opened the curtain and walked in. What he saw inside was Su Wan who had changed her clothes.
She was still wearing the same green uniform, but today she didn't have the rush of yesterday, and she looked more peaceful.
The green clothes fit perfectly and decorated her slender figure well. The slightly tightened waist and the slight bulge in the front look great.
Su Wan was writing quietly on a desk. After Zhang Shou'an came in, she raised her head and looked over.
But Zhang Shou'an could see it. Her ears turned slightly red, as if she remembered what happened yesterday.
"What's the matter, sir?" Su Wan asked softly.
Zhang Shou'an got straight to the point: "I'm here to see if you have any ready-made elixirs. I'll need them when I enter the secret realm in a few days."
Su Wan was stunned for a moment, then walked to the corner and pulled out a backpack.
He turned it over several times, finally took out a few porcelain bottles and said, "That's all."
He took the porcelain bottles and placed them on the table in front of Zhang Shou'an.
She picked up one, shook it, and then said based on her feeling: "There are about seven or eight hemostatic pills in it."
"Whether it is an ordinary skin injury or an internal injury, it can be treated. It can be cured within a few seconds after taking it. However, the effect and pain will be different."
She handed it to Zhang Shou'an: "Of course, it's not that magical. When used by monks above the Qi training stage, the effect can be described as nothing."
title_en: Chapter 42: Alchemy Chapter 41: The Secret Realm You Can Ask
